facts.note: 12 entries declined: this surface drops a citation whose URL changes under redaction, so a contextual pattern would silently discard legitimate results

portedInvariant: Text the harness passes on can carry a credential the session was never configured with, and a span whose shape a provider published is replaced with the redaction token, keeping the text around it.

wiring.note: the existing redact helper returns through the shape pass, after the known-secret loop, so query, title, snippet and citation URL all go through both; a URL that changes under either pass is still dropped rather than rewritten (src/web-search.ts:155)

ownedDecisions: Only the precise half of the table is carried. The twelve contextual entries are absent because this surface drops a citation whose URL changes under redaction, so a pattern matching an ordinary user:password URL, the word before an equals sign or a 20-character header value would silently discard legitimate search results. The test asserts the absence so re-adding one is deliberate.

The local token is used, not the recovered one: this surface already writes [redacted], and one string can carry known-secret and shape redactions together, so one spelling beats two tokens in one output.

The captured span is replaced rather than the whole match, because several recovered patterns carry trailing boundary context and replacing the whole match would eat the delimiter; this is what the recovered substitution does.

The displayRun boundary form is folded into the plain patterns: each carried GitLab family already spells its own prefix, so a partial match inside a longer token is impossible without the extra lookbehind machinery.
The table is compiled once and re-used, with lastIndex reset semantics asserted, because the recovered code takes the same care over a table entry compiled once and looped over.
credentialShapeIds is exported for diagnosis; redaction itself does not need to know which rule fired.
The confidence field is not carried as a runtime value: it existed to decide which entries get prefix anchoring, and every carried entry is anchored by its own format.
notPorted: The twelve low-confidence entries, listed above with the reason.

The prefilter and redactOnly machinery: no carried entry needs a prefilter (the loose JWT that did is not carried), and redactOnly marks an entry that redacts without counting as a finding, which has no meaning on a surface that only redacts.
The confidence grading as a runtime value.
The module's other half (markdown link rewriting): out of scope for this surface.

added: every family in the table has a sample and every sample matches its own id, over 52 fixtures built from each provider's published prefix
a recognized span is replaced with its surroundings intact, a pattern carrying trailing context replaces only the token, and several spans in one string are all replaced
ordinary text is untouched: prose about prefixes, short URLs, a documented prefix on its own, and near-misses one character short of a format
the ambiguous entries are absent from the table and the shapes they would have caught are left alone, so https://user:password@example.test/ and an assignment to a password field are not rewritten
the compiled table carries no state between calls: a repeated match still redacts on the second occurrence and the id list is stable

cliSmoke.reason: the table is a pure function of its input and the existing web-search fixture already drives the surface the rule lands on, including the case added there.

regressions: None. The known-secret case is unchanged - the shape pass is a no-op on a string carrying no provider-shaped token - and the existing web-search cases pass unmodified.
limitations: The table covers the 52 provider formats the recovered set states precisely; a credential of a format not in the table and not known to the session is not recognized.

The substitution is a text rewrite: it removes a recognized span wherever it appears in the text this surface re-emits, and does not attempt to decide whether the surrounding sentence was about a credential.
No real search provider was contacted; the end-to-end case runs against the owned fixture server.
